We are searching for a mid level engineer ready to take complete ownership of our rapidly expanding data center network across multiple continents. This is an empowering role where you will be instrumental in designing, architecting, and optimizing our complex global connectivity. You will dive deep into cutting-edge technologies, including Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, and advanced routing protocols (BGP). Critically, while you will own the network domain, you will also be deeply embedded in the wider Infrastructure team. This provides a clear, defined path for you to grow into all areas of our Infra stack—from Linux compute and storage to Kubernetes and site reliability engineering (SRE). If you are passionate about building resilient, secure, and scalable networks, and are eager for a role where your expertise acts as the core architectural decision-maker with clear opportunities to expand your career into overall infrastructure leadership, we can’t wait to connect with you. This is a 5-day in-office position built for maximum impact. Direct, high-bandwidth collaboration is key to the level of Network Ownership and accelerated cross-functional growth we offer. Be in the room to influence architecture, partner with senior leadership, and make immediate, high-stakes decisions that drive the business forward. We believe that we are better together than apart. Key Responsibilities This role is for an engineer who will support network architecture while contributing across the broader infrastructure. Implement, optimize, and scale the global data center backbone to ensure high availability and security. Contribute to the implementation and refinement of Juniper EVPN-VXLAN fabric for scalable overlay networks in our cloud environment. Configure and manage mission-critical routing protocols (BGP,IPSec,ICCP) to ensure resilient, high-performance global connectivity. Configure and maintain security policies using enterprise-grade firewalls (Fortinet, or similar). Collaborate with Infrastructure, SRE, and Development teams to integrate networking solutions with compute, storage and cloud systems (Kubernetes/Ceph). Develop and maintain automation scripts (Python,Bash,Ansible) to streamline network provisioning and scaling. Utilize and support network observability tools (Prometheus,Grafana) for infrastructure monitoring and insight. Provide effective troubleshooting and resolution for network incidents of varying complexity to minimize downtime. Requirements 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Network Engineer proficient in Juniper EVPN-VXLAN, advanced routing, and enterprise firewalls. Working knowledge of core routing protocols BGP/IPSec for scaling global data center networks. Strong proficiency in Linux and proven ability to automate tasks using Python, Bash, or Ansible. Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana for proactive network monitoring and actionable insights. Experience in configuring firewalls and implementing network security best practices. Ability to independently troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues. Proactive approach to learning and adopting new technologies across the infrastructure stack. Willingness to occasionally travel to data centers for on-site deployments and maintenance. Nice to Have: Advanced troubleshooting utilities: grep, awk, sed, and tcpdump. ​​​​​​​Implementing Anycast for scalable network resilience. ​​​​​​​Integrating network solutions with Kubernetes and CNI. Optimizing performance on Juniper QFX series switches. Why work for us? We are a Great Place to Work-Certified™ company and the global leader in cloud-based access control and video surveillance. Following our merger with Eagle Eye Networks, we are building the only platform powerful enough to support the future of AI-driven security. Why Your Work Matters Innovation drives our vibe, but purpose drives our mission. You will work on essential systems that protect the health, safety, and welfare of people and property worldwide. At Brivo, your voice is heard, your talent is respected, and your contributions have a global impact. The Brivo Experience: We thrive on in-person collaboration and a "one-team" atmosphere. We embrace our international presence, leveraging diverse ideas and backgrounds to improve our culture and our products. To keep our global teams connected and inspired, we provide a premium onsite experience featuring communal meals, recurring social events, and fully stocked workspaces—ensuring you have everything you need to stay focused while building the future of security. Total Rewards: Diverse team with 20+ nationalities 23 paid holidays yearly + Dutch public holidays Compensation for travel expenses from your home to the office; Company equipment for work use; Enrollment in our collective pension plan; Drinks, Snacks, & fully subsidized lunch at the AMS office; Company swag, business casual scale-up work atmosphere and after work drinks; Once or twice a year a stunning company day; Individual compensation packages are based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, training, and market conditions. In addition, Brivonians enjoy a robust benefits and perks package tailored to their work location. About Brivo Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises. As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure. With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
